title: 정정보도청구 등 사건 심판규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Hearings and Adjudication)
(1) Where a court hears a case concerning a request for a corrective report, etc., it shall hold oral arguments.
(2) Where an application for a corrective report, etc. is unlawful and the defect cannot be corrected, the court may dismiss it by decision without oral arguments.
(3) Upon receipt of an application for a corrective report, etc., the court shall promptly designate a date for oral arguments, except in the case described in paragraph (2).
(4) Article 280 (2) through (4), Article 282, and Article 288 of the Civil Execution Act shall not apply to adjudication of an application for a corrective report, etc.
(5) An authentic copy of the judgment on an application for a corrective report, etc. shall be served on the parties.
